title: Mana Potions
html:
Mana Potions

Mana potions restore a large portion of your mana over a certain length of time. There are two types of mana potions. They are minor mana potions and major mana potions.

  • Minor mana potions can be used by both nonmembers and members, they regenerate 40% health over 5 seconds. They can be stacked up piles of 5 maximum.
  • Major mana potions can only be used by members, they regenerate 50% of your mana over 5 secs and the restoration effects stack. They can be stacked up to 10.
